issues.reason: The mis-slot stands — QuantifierPhrase's first slot is specified as the quantified KIND (or a group's kind), never an individual witness, and the instruction set's own remedy for an unrepresentable frequency adverbial is to 'leave it out rather than mis-slot it' — but the demand for a habitual rule / a strength from 'occasionally' does not: the generic machinery needs a kind range, which a witness subject with a named recipient cannot supply (the reviewer's own gap).
The atom is false — an ex-boyfriend is not a boyfriend — and the calibration line makes falsehood decisive however the compound-genus rule reads.

The reviewer's own gap concedes nothing licenses an attachment for a proper-noun modifier on a common noun, and (Possession michael_bergin baywatch) is true in the loose-association sense Possession is explicitly opaque over, so the calibration line makes it acceptable improvisation.

Sealing the narrator's appositive under the tell event's Theme asserts that she told John that characterization — more than the text states — while the projection rule requires a definite referent's Member typing atom at top level beside the wrapper (only the Name was projected).

gaps_confirmed: privative / non-subsective modifiers ('ex-boyfriend') — the compound-kind genus rule licenses an Inheritance the modifier cancels
discourse adverbial 'in turn' — no licensed encoding, and the parse drops it
a frequency adverb over a past habitual with individuated participants ('occasionally told John') — the generic route needs a kind range and QuantifierPhrase needs a kind
verb + preposition ('sleep with') — the phrasal-verb fusion rule and the prepositional-verb oblique rule both claim it, with no tiebreak
a proper-noun noun-modifier ('"Baywatch" hunk') — no way to relate the named modifier to its head noun
new_gaps: non-restrictive appositive material contributed by the REPORTER inside a reported-speech seal: the projection rule covers a definite's typing but says nothing about lifting narrator-attributed description out of the seal, nor whether it then takes the host clause's Past wrapper (the repair lifts it unwrapped)
repair_summary: Removed (: e_tell_q (QuantifierPhrase sk_person_1 tell "occasionally") ...) — an individual in a kind slot, with no licensed substitute for the frequency adverb; removed the false (Inheritance ex_boyfriend boyfriend) from the sealed term; lifted the narrator's appositive atoms (Member michael_bergin hunk) and (Possession michael_bergin baywatch) out of the seal to top level as mb_hunk / mb_baywatch.
notes: (Member michael_bergin ex_boyfriend) stays sealed — that predication is part of what she told John — and the compound symbol ex_boyfriend itself is kept, only its false genus removed.
